beats.purpose: Stop the scroll with origin and texture.
beats.action: Macro coffee surface shimmers; steam drifts; the origin word lands.

beats.purpose: Reveal the pack and name the format.
beats.action: The pack rises into hero light; the label catches a single sweep.
Liquid wraps the pack; the splash peaks and falls.
End card holds logo, pack and CTA.

shots.purpose: Earn the next two seconds with origin and texture.
shots.framing: Full-frame macro; type centered in the upper third.
shots.movement: Slow push-in on the coffee surface; steam drifts right.
shots.subject: Dark coffee surface, steam and the word ETHIOPIA.
shots.action: The origin word lands on beat one and holds.
shots.lighting: Low-key warm key from the right; copper rim.
shots.palette: Near-black brown, cream type, copper highlight.
shots.continuity: Coffee texture carries into the pack reveal.
shots.method: Authored motion-graphics composite: macro plate, steam element, kinetic type.
shots.fallback_method: Static macro still with a slow scale and a type fade.

shots.purpose: Reveal the pack and name the format.
shots.framing: Pack hero at center, label square to camera.
shots.movement: Pack rises 40 px; a single light sweep crosses left to right.
shots.subject: Ethiopia pack with an unobstructed label.
shots.lighting: Warm key on the pack; dark surround.
shots.continuity: Same warm grade and pack orientation as SH-03 and SH-04.
shots.method: Pack hero composite with supplied art, light sweep and type.
shots.fallback_method: Pack still on seamless background with a simple gradient.

shots.purpose: Deliver the sensory payoff and hold the label.
shots.framing: Pack fills the frame; liquid wraps the lower half.
shots.movement: Slow push-in; liquid peaks at frame 150 and falls.
shots.subject: Pack, liquid ribbon and macro bubbles.
shots.action: Splash peaks, then settles around the pack.
shots.lighting: Backlit liquid with a warm edge.
shots.continuity: Pack label remains unobstructed; same pack scale direction.
shots.method: Liquid and macro composite around the pack with type.
shots.fallback_method: Pack hero still with an animated light sweep; no liquid simulation.

shots.purpose: Close on brand and a clear CTA.
shots.framing: Logo top-center, pack center, CTA and caption below.
shots.movement: Pack settles; CTA fades up on the final beat.
shots.subject: Logo, pack and CTA.
shots.action: End card holds for the final read.
shots.lighting: Even warm key; logo separated from background.
shots.palette: Cream logo, copper pack, near-black ground.
shots.continuity: Final pack orientation matches SH-02 and SH-03.
shots.method: End-card composite: logo, pack, CTA and caption.
shots.fallback_method: Typographic end card with logo and CTA if pack art is unavailable.

checks.description: Timeline covers exactly 250 frames across four contiguous shots.
All text sits inside the 1080x1920 safe area.

No required layer depends on unapproved price or offer data.

held_items.reason: The storefront price varies by pack size and the offer has no visible expiry or terms.
held_items.required_evidence: Brand-approved hero size, advertising price, offer terms and expiry, with a named approver.

decisions.selected: No price or promotion in the ready cut.
alternatives: Hold the price and offer for a later approved version
decisions.rationale: The price varies by pack size and the offer terms are not visible. Putting either in the ready cut would turn an observation into an advertising claim.

decisions.selected: Premium product-led hero, with a character route as an alternative.
decisions.rationale: A product hero communicates the SKU and brand fastest in ten seconds. The character route is credible but spends too much time before the product appears.

decisions.selected: Four shots over 250 frames: 2s hook, 3s reveal, 3s payoff, 2s close.
decisions.rationale: Four beats give the pack enough hold for label recognition while keeping the cut under ten seconds.

decisions.selected: Inter under the SIL OFL as a documented placeholder.
decisions.rationale: The plan needs a concrete typographic specification. Inter is legally clear and easy to replace when the brand kit arrives.

decisions.selected: Use only the approved descriptor 'speciality instant coffee'.
decisions.rationale: The other claims need substantiation and approved advertising wording. The category descriptor is verified and sufficient for this cut.

assumptions: Audience is inferred from the INR storefront and specialty range.
Safe area is a provisional operator assumption, not a platform guarantee.
Inter (SIL OFL 1.1) is a documented placeholder for the brand font.
Music and VO are planned as one licence and one human session.
Pack size is not chosen; no price appears in the ready cut.
